description: This header file defines functions and classes for joining ranges of elements into a string, with customizable formatting options. It includes default formatters, helper functions, and multiple overloads of the StrJoin function for different container types and ranges.

methods.name: AlphaNumFormatter
methods.description: Returns the default formatter using absl::AlphaNum for numeric conversions.

methods.name: StreamFormatter
methods.description: Returns a formatter that uses the << operator for formatting.

methods.name: PairFormatter
methods.description: Creates a formatter for std::pair with a specified separator and optional custom formatters for first and second elements.

methods.name: DereferenceFormatter
methods.description: Creates a formatter that dereferences pointers and applies a given formatter.
